title: Replace period-leading classification with structured COBOL control flow
digest_scope: Recursively lexicographically key-sorted compact UTF-8 JSON serialization of control_receipt, with no trailing newline, followed by SHA-256
acceptance_observations: Line-aware typed nodes retain nested IF, EVALUATE, SEARCH, and inline PERFORM ownership; explicit END-* and period-implied scope ends remain distinguishable.
Paragraph PERFORM and THRU resolve to deterministic call and return edges, while VARYING, TIMES, and UNTIL forms create bounded structured scopes with explicit true, false, and loop edges.
GO TO and NEXT SENTENCE resolve transfer edges; EXIT, GOBACK, STOP RUN, branches, labels, generic scope terminators, and fallthrough retain distinct control roles.
COBOL sentence splitting ignores decimal points, retained source comments, quoted text, and periods inside EXEC CICS, SQL, and DLI blocks.

Unknown statements, unmatched scopes, unterminated host blocks, and missing internal targets fail HIR construction. The one literal duplicate paragraph in the pinned corpus is a typed recovered node whose unsupported statement kind prevents publication.

Multiline structured control is also marked unsupported until its explicit graph is consumed by core lowering, while the historical single-line executable forms remain available; the login closure therefore reaches a typed CD-006 boundary without publishing partial behavior.
SQL INCLUDE-owned paragraph targets are external typed nodes only in an already unsupported embedded-SQL closure, so incomplete include expansion cannot publish.
The exact length-delimited control digest covers statement kinds, source lines, arguments, node roles, scopes, parents, text, and every edge for all 44 explicit source closures.
